episodes.title: A Scandal in Bohemia
episodes.summary: Sherlock Holmes finds himself evenly matched when he is employed by the King of Bohemia to retrieve an indiscreet photograph from the American actress and singer, Irene Adler.

episodes.title: The Dancing Men
episodes.summary: A gentleman is baffled when the childish drawings of little dancing men terrify his American wife. Sherlock Holmes soon discovers why.

episodes.title: The Naval Treaty
episodes.summary: An unknown thief steals an important naval treaty from a Foreign Office clerk. Sherlock Holmes sets out to find it.

episodes.title: The Solitary Cyclist
episodes.summary: A strange man on a bicycle follows a young music teacher as she bicycles on a lonely road to and from the city.

episodes.title: The Crooked Man
episodes.summary: Colonel Barclay is found dead and his wife is arrested for the murder, but Holmes is convinced a missing door key will reveal the true killer.

episodes.title: The Speckled Band
episodes.summary: A young woman asks for Holmes' help when her ill-tempered stepfather moves her into the same room where her sister died under mysterious circumstances.

episodes.title: The Blue Carbuncle
episodes.summary: When the Countess of Morcar's priceless blue carbuncle is stolen, a reformed thief is charged with the crime.

episodes.title: The Copper Beeches
episodes.summary: Mr. Rucastle's odd requirements for governess Violet Hunter alarm her, so she seeks Holmes' advice.

episodes.title: The Greek Interpreter
episodes.summary: An unsavory gang kidnaps a Greek interpreter and forces him to relate their demands to an abductee who knows only the Greek tongue.

episodes.title: The Norwood Builder
episodes.summary: When a notorious retired builder is found dead, his recently-named heir is the prime suspect.

episodes.title: The Resident Patient
episodes.summary: A mysterious man sets up a new doctor in a posh practice for a percentage of the doctor's fees.

episodes.title: The Red-Headed League
episodes.summary: What seems at first to be a harmless prank played upon a red-headed man is soon revealed to be much more; a sinister scheme devised by the Napoleon of Crime.

episodes.title: The Final Problem
episodes.summary: Holmes and Watson travel to Europe to escape Moriarty's vengeance.

episodes.title: The Empty House
episodes.summary: Believed dead after his fatal encounter with Professor Moriarity three years earlier, Sherlock Holmes returns to England to foil a plot to murder him by a former Moriarity gang member.

episodes.title: The Abbey Grange
episodes.summary: Holmes is called to a manor house to investigate the brutal murder of a country lord with a fireplace poker, and reconcile the story of his bruised and battered wife with the facts.

episodes.title: The Musgrave Ritual
episodes.summary: An obscure family document containing an enigmatic ritual holds the key to a hidden treasure if Holmes can decipher the mystery.

episodes.title: The Second Stain
episodes.summary: Holmes is asked by the country's Prime Minister to aid in the recovery of a stolen diplomatic letter, which, if published, might lead England into war.

episodes.title: The Man with the Twisted Lip
episodes.summary: Responding to a grieving wife, Holmes investigates the apparent murder of her husband in an apartment above an opium den.

episodes.title: The Priory School
episodes.summary: The headmaster of a prestigious prep school calls on Holmes for help when the ten year old only son of powerful duke disappears.

episodes.title: The Six Napoleons
episodes.summary: Inspector Lastrade reveals to Holmes that someone has been breaking into homes for the senseless purpose of destroying small busts of Napoleon.

episodes.title: The Sign of Four
episodes.summary: The disappearance of a young woman's father, and a mysterious note years later after the strange regular annual delivery of valuable pearls to her, puts Sherlock Holmes on the case.

episodes.title: The Devil's Foot
episodes.summary: While convalescing in Cornwall, a depressive Holmes investigates the apparent death from apoplexy of a local woman and the unexplained sudden dementia of her two brothers.

episodes.title: Silver Blaze
episodes.summary: Holmes investigates the disappearance of a champion racehorse and the murder of its trainer on a lonely moor.

episodes.title: Wisteria Lodge
episodes.summary: A bored Holmes eagerly accepts a case involving the disappearance of an amateur Spanish cartographer, as well as his servants, from his rented country lodge.

episodes.title: The Bruce Partington Plans
episodes.summary: Sherlock's brother, Mycroft, enlists his younger sibling to locate missing patent plans that pertain to a strategically critical state-of-the-art submarine.

episodes.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
episodes.summary: When the latest heir to the Baskerville estate seems to be threatened by a family curse, only the master detective, Sherlock Holmes, can find out the truth.

episodes.title: The Disappearance of Lady Frances Carfax
episodes.summary: Holmes must save a suffragette after Watson meets her and notices she is troubled by a mysterious bearded man.

episodes.title: The Problem of Thor Bridge
episodes.summary: A governess is arrested for the murder of her employer's wife.

episodes.title: Shoscombe Old Place
episodes.summary: The horse trainer of a debt-ridden aristocrat consults Holmes about his employer's behaviour.

episodes.title: The Boscombe Valley Mystery
episodes.summary: When William McCarthy is found dead, the son with whom he had just quarreled is charged with murder.

episodes.title: The Illustrious Client
episodes.summary: Sir James Damery asks Holmes to stop a general's daughter from marrying a philandering, but seductively attractive, murderer.

episodes.title: The Creeping Man
episodes.summary: Holmes thinks a woman's claim to have seen a man at her upstairs bedroom window is related to the theft of several apes.

episodes.title: The Master Blackmailer
episodes.summary: Holmes and Watson attempt to break the grip of a ruthless blackmailer on of their clients.

episodes.title: The Last Vampyre
episodes.summary: Sherlock Holmes is called upon to investigate a series of deaths which seem to be related to John Stockton, who is rumoured to be descended from a family of vampires.

episodes.title: The Eligible Bachelor
episodes.summary: Holmes suffers from disturbing dreams as he helps to find the missing wife of Lord Robert St. Simon.

episodes.title: The Three Gables
episodes.summary: After her grandson's death, an old woman consults Holmes, after refusing a strange offer to buy her house including all its contents.

episodes.title: The Dying Detective
episodes.summary: A man dies of a mysterious tropical disease on which his cousin, his heir, is the sole authority.

episodes.title: The Golden Pince-Nez
episodes.summary: Holmes and Mycroft investigate the murder of a professor's assistant who died clutching a woman's pince-nez.

episodes.title: The Red Circle
episodes.summary: Mrs. Hudson asks Holmes to help her friend with a lodger who insists on nobody entering his room, and his secret past is uncovered.

episodes.title: The Mazarin Stone
episodes.summary: Mycroft investigates when the Mazarin Stone is stolen from a museum, and Watson deals with the promise of a large inheritance if a third person with the surname of Garrideb can be found.

episodes.title: The Cardboard Box
episodes.summary: Susan Cushing asks Holmes' help in solving the disappearance of her sister Mary Browner, but it doesn't seem Holmes' type of case until he is told of a Christmas present's grisly contents.
